title: Proposed: random-entry null test before any mutation
detail: Compare Gamma MNQ and Beta MNQ longs against random long entries at the same times of day, with the same exits. If they don't beat the null at p < 0.05, the long PF is just market drift.
oosImpact: Superseded: agents retired. The null-test discipline carries into H3 (random-direction null).
